messages.content: Nick had twice as many candies as George. Then George ate 5 candies. Now George has 3 candies left. How many candies does Nick have?

content.text:
If George has 3 candies left after eating 5, he originally had 3 + 5 = **8 candies**.

Nick had twice as many as George, so Nick had 2 × 8 = **16 candies**.
